[b]How to get the hand mirror?
[/b]- On the current version used for this mod in [b]Fashion Sense 6.6.0[/b], you either check the box[b] [Start with mirror][/b] at the start of a new save file
and [b]check your mailbox[/b] [i][color=#00ff00]or[/color][color=#0000ff] [/color] [/i]buy it at Pierre the mod also says to use the console command[b] fs_add_mirror[/b] to force it into your inventory but i haven't tried this.
